notes.title: New cool update
notes.content:
[b][h1]Today I fixed some bugs and added something cool![/h1][/b]
[list]
    [*]The interface of multiplayer has become more understandable.
    [*]When you exit the multiplayer character does not disappear.
    [*]Added a score counter in multiplayer.
    [*]Added new skins for the character.
[/list]

[b][h1]In our plans:[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] Add the rating of players in multiplayer.
[*] To improve multiplayer.
[*] Add more obstacles.
[/list]

[b] If you want to offer us cooperation or improvement of the game, please contact us by mail: [/b] 

[u]vikul.vlad@mail.ru[/u]

P.S. Thank you for being with us!
